_question: Heat Sheet (v2): does each essential state change keep an equivalent non-motion communication under reduced motion? Mappings are from the full-motion carrier to the reduced carrier.

mappings.full: a full-bleed patchwork title card with the project count is cut away tile by tile in about half a second, once per session
mappings.reduced: not shown; the page and the count in the protocol strip appear directly

mappings.full: spring rotation of the rack; the giant title clips away upward in 120 ms
mappings.reduced: instant reposition; the title is replaced at once; the position number and tracklist row change immediately

mappings.full: the case pulls straight out, turns and floats to the presentation spot (gated springs)
mappings.reduced: the gate sequence resolves within one frame; the case is shown presented

mappings.full: title stamps in with a two-frame misregistered copy in the case colour
mappings.reduced: title shown at once; no misregistered copy is drawn

mappings.full: capsule code, standfirst and meta uncover left to right over 220 ms
mappings.reduced: label text appears at once; the status region announces the case in both modes

mappings.full: ring and leader draw on over 300 ms, then the label appears
mappings.reduced: ring, leader and label shown complete

mappings.full: front leaf swings on its hinge and the case moves beside the spread
mappings.reduced: case shown open beside the spread

mappings.full: spread slides in from the right over 420 ms; title stamps
mappings.reduced: spread shown without the slide; focus moves to Close

mappings.full: on filter or sort, cases sink through the floor, re-slot unseen and rise from the front out
mappings.reduced: slots change in place at once; the tracklist shows the new order

mappings.full: edge rail marker snaps in 100 ms
mappings.reduced: marker moves at once; the label number is the same

mappings.full: tracklist scrolls smoothly to the current row
mappings.reduced: tracklist jumps to the current row
